questions.funFact: This is temporary test content for Han's first-birthday quiz app.

questions.prompt: How many candles would normally go on a first-birthday cake?
questions.funFact: One candle represents one completed year and gives the birthday baby one very important wish.

questions.prompt: Which item is most useful when a baby decides that lunch belongs on the floor?
questions.funFact: A bib cannot stop every food adventure, but it can make the clean-up slightly less dramatic.

questions.prompt: What should guests do after selecting an answer on their phone?

answers.label: Confirm and wait for the reveal

questions.funFact: Each guest can submit only once per question, so the confirmation step should be intentional.

questions.prompt: How long does each test question stay open?
questions.funFact: The quiz currently uses one global 20-second timer for every question.

questions.prompt: Which answer would probably make a one-year-old happiest at a party?

answers.label: Music, colourful decorations, and familiar faces

questions.funFact: This deliberately longer answer helps test wrapping and spacing on smaller phone screens.

questions.prompt: What happens when the answer timer reaches zero?

answers.label: The question locks and late answers are rejected
The quiz returns to the welcome screen

questions.funFact: The server-authoritative deadline prevents answers submitted at or after the deadline from being accepted.

questions.prompt: How many points does a correct answer currently receive?
questions.funFact: The current scoring mode is correct-count: one point for a correct answer and zero for an incorrect answer.

questions.prompt: If two guests finish with the same score, what does the current leaderboard use next?

answers.label: Who answered the final question fastest
Participant join order, then display name

questions.funFact: The current leaderboard does not use a speed bonus. Ties are resolved deterministically.

questions.prompt: What is the most important goal of this temporary 10-question rehearsal?

answers.label: To permanently record fictional facts about Han
To verify the complete guest, host, display, scoring, reveal, and leaderboard flow
To replace the final birthday celebration

questions.funFact: After the full rehearsal passes, these temporary questions will be replaced with Ian's approved real birthday questions.
